summary.plain: The international group of institutions designing the Southern Wide-field Gamma-ray Observatory, a planned water-tank array for the southern sky.
summary.technical: International R&D collaboration, formed by an agreement signed 1 July 2019, that has developed the design of SWGO and selected its Chilean site; more than 90 institutions from 16 partner countries.
